problem: Independent per-share ROUND_HALF_UP breaks the invariant that shares sum to amount (allocate('100',[1,1,1]) sums to 99.99; allocate('0.05',[1,1]) sums to 0.06).
The correct result of _ref.allocate(...) is discarded and recomputed incorrectly, and allocate.py now depends on reference_impl.
Recomputation uses default 28-digit Decimal context instead of exact Fraction arithmetic, so large or high-precision inputs can round silently.
Duplicate Decimal import, and Fraction and _to_decimal are now unused (ruff F401/F811).
